=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh:62-86, 159-169 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The helper copies only the legacy sensitive() rules (bad_parts, .env*, key_suffixes) from scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh. It leaves out pass2_credential_names, pass2_secret_tails, the .jks/.tfstate suffixes and pass2_secret_name(), so tracked credential-shaped paths (e.g. db-credentials.yaml, config/prod_secret.json, .npmrc, .ssh/id_rsa) can be counted and named in the retry prompt and in the CLARIFY_BLOCKED_VERIFY sample= log field.
  WHY: The snapshot never ships or lists these files, so naming them in the retry prompt and the logs breaks the snapshot's "never counted or listed" contract and steers the model toward hidden credential files (names only, not contents). test_sensitive_rules_mirror_the_snapshot pins only bad_parts and key suffixes, so the drift goes undetected. All four reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:146 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The new tracked script scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh is referenced in README.md:112 and the agents.d fragment, but it has no docs/INVENTORY.md Scripts entry and no tests/inventory_exemptions.txt exemption.
  WHY: tests/inventory_parity.py fails ("FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/clarify_blocked_verify.sh", "FAIL: README.md:112: ...", "FAIL: agents.md:1857: ...") and exits 1, so CI cannot pass. docs/INVENTORY.md is outside the files_touched grant (rated BLOCKER).

  PROBLEM: The legacy_support/helper_missing skip branch prints a CLARIFY_BLOCKED_VERIFY stage=verify outcome=skip line without checking CLARIFY_BLOCKED_VERIFY_ENABLED, and its plain grep ignores code fences.
  WHY: The documented stable-log-prefix contract says the line is silent when there is no unfenced BLOCKED: line or the switch is off, so log consumers miscount skips. Retry behaviour is unaffected. All four reviewers rated it NIT.

It does not copy pass2_credential_names, pass2_secret_tails or pass2_secret_name() (scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh lines 163-178), so files such as config/prod_secret.json, deploy/.npmrc and infra/db-credentials.yaml are counted and can be named in the "e.g." examples, in "(tracked file)" lines and in the sample= field.
